newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - mogas drops, fuel steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - mogas drops, fuel steady.

text.p: NWE oil products ended the week mixed, traders said.
Gasoline took a pounding losing $3 or so as NYMEX slumped. Wet eurograde barges dipped below $190 fob and August swaps were talked to $186.50, off $6 or so.
Spot gas oil prices were slightly weaker with bench IPE gas oil easing in correction to Thursday's gains and slack buying interest putting pressuring barge and cargo premiums.
Good supply coming out of Ventspils was seen starting to pressure premiums for 0.2 sulphur cargoes while in contrast diesel remained well supported.
The naphtha physical market was again talked well above the previous day's levels, although no trades were heard to confirm the fresh climb that followed price jumps Wednesday and Thursday.

But while prompt cargo bids and offers were reported Friday afternoon at $194 and $195 CIF NWE respectively, $3-$4 higher than Thursday's deal level, naphtha swaps were steady or slightly weaker on lower crude futures values.
High sulphur fuel oil barges ended the week on the upside but off highs seen in early trade with demand said to have waned.

High sulphur cargoes corrected a little to the $83 cif level after barges moved to trade at lower levels. One percent was offered steady to a little higher at $96 with prospects seen for trans-Atlantic shipment.
